bio: Today I'm a Forward Deployed Engineer at Tamtam, an AI sales intelligence startup: I work inside customers' setups and turn what keeps coming up there into product. Before that I was the Growth Engineer at Finary, where I built ten internal tools that gave the teams back about 190 hours a month.
I like to understand a team's problem before I join it: three of the products below were built to get hired, and two of them did the job.
I'm in the final year of a business and engineering double degree, Audencia × Centrale Nantes (BBA Big Data, AI & Management).
